# Saved pre-refactor outputs

These fixtures were generated by pre-refactor code, not the new implementation.
`provenance.json` records repository bases, the initial dirty patch SHA256, the
latest dirty traditional recovery source, the original geometry/observation
headers, unchanged deployed model hashes and each fixture hash. The local source
snapshot remains under `/tmp/rmcs-wheel-leg-baseline-e_x1t2v3`; the original user
worktrees were preserved. Later concurrent changes in the original RMCS checkout
are outside this frozen baseline.

| Files | Input and expected output |
| --- | --- |
| observation.input, prone.expected, wheelbipe.expected | 240 reset/enable, multi-turn and extreme-angle frames per adapter; input schema matches wheel_leg_observation_parity.cpp |
| gas.input / gas.expected | 24 joint-pose samples including domain endpoints and extrapolation; schema matches wheel_leg_gas_spring_parity.cpp |
| traditional.input / traditional.expected | 1200 sequential trajectory frames, resets, speed and height transitions; old WheelLegTrajectoryController::update() executed with original wheelleg_sim.yaml |
| execution.input / execution.expected | 384 independent deterministic samples (seed 109): profile 0/1, model q[6], dq[6], raw action[6], torque caps[6]; expected target[6], applied history[6], API torque[6] |

The execution generator compiled the old action.cpp method bodies unchanged in a
minimal interface shim, with PC PD, current ProneMotion/WheelBipe profiles, the
original gas spring and paired-winding helpers. It exercised the original target
mapping, history, PD, hinge projection and final effort conversion. The trajectory
generator used the original component constructor/update, exposing private inputs
only in the temporary generator translation unit. Other fixtures ran the original
observation/gas probe sources against the initial snapshot.

Old and new probes run in the same development Docker/compiler/libm environment.
Observations and gas outputs compare equal after parsing; trajectory and execution
use 1e-12 absolute tolerance. Host libm is not asserted bitwise equivalent.

`verify_wheel_leg_baseline.py` is registered as `wheel_leg_golden_parity` in CTest.
It accepts the four built production probes plus this directory. Run the package
suite after build-rmcs; no original source snapshot is needed to consume the saved
fixtures. Source generators are local baseline artifacts, not runtime compatibility
layers. This comparison establishes deterministic software contracts, not robot
capability or hardware acceptance.

`validation.json` records build/test and training/native probe evidence. Native
recovery probes use the new shared recovery ABI; their post-handoff plant controller
is the existing native traditional implementation, not the new ROS main component.
